============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |   1239 ns | 807,242 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1663 ns | 601,356 | 341 | 1.34x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   3065 ns | 326,303 | 341 | 2.47x slower |
| google-protobuf |   6619 ns | 151,089 | 341 | 5.34x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   4583 ns | 218,175 | 622 | 3.70x slower |
| JSON |   2439 ns | 410,052 | 791 | 1.97x slower |
